title: Global Zira Storage Cabinet Credenza — 72"W x 24"D
body_html:
A full 72 inches of lockable, soft-close storage that looks built-in and arrives ready to use.

The Global Zira Storage Cabinet Credenza pairs a 72"W x 24"D x 30"H laminate case with locking doors across the board and one adjustable shelf per door pair, so every file, supply, and personal item has a secure home. Soft-close hinges and clean laminate detailing give it the finished look of casework, while Zira's thermally fused laminate construction stands up to daily institutional use. It ships fully assembled — set it in place and it is ready to load.

Key features

  • Full-height credenza-style storage with locking doors throughout
  • One adjustable shelf per pair of doors for flexible interior organization
  • Soft-close hinges standard for quiet, controlled door movement
  • 1" thick laminate surfaces with high-quality construction details
  • Ships fully assembled — no on-site build required

Who it’s for

Private offices, administrative suites, and shared work areas in municipal, education, and healthcare environments that need secure, good-looking storage along a wall or behind a desk.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
